description: Angular component for a dynamic form select item row, including validation, form control management, and event handling.

classes.name: DynamicFormSelectItemRowComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a form row for selecting items with validation and change detection.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form controls with provided value.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the form controls.

methods.name: selectItemValueValidator
methods.description: Validator function to ensure item value is unique and present.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the model value and propagates change.
